files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: get_spreadsheet_id
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a managed Google Sheets spreadsheet by its human-readable title and returns the spreadsheet’s ID when a match is found. Requests are refused when the title is missing/blank, when no spreadsheet with that title is available to this service, or when the title is ambiguous because multiple accessible spreadsheets share the same name.

tool_schemas.name: read_values
tool_schemas.description: Reads cell values from the specified spreadsheet and returns the rows of values found in the requested worksheet or A1 range. Requests are refused when the spreadsheet cannot be resolved by the provided ID/title, when the range/worksheet is not valid for that spreadsheet, or when the service does not have permission to read that spreadsheet.

tool_schemas.name: update_values
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the values in the given worksheet or A1 range with the provided 2D array and returns the updated range/values as applied. Requests are refused when the spreadsheet or range cannot be resolved, when the values payload is not a rectangular 2D array suitable for the target range, or when the service lacks permission to edit the spreadsheet (including when the target sheet/range is protected).

tool_schemas.name: append_rows
tool_schemas.description: Appends the provided rows to the end of the given worksheet (defaulting to "Sheet1" when not supplied) and returns details of the append, such as where the rows were written. Requests are refused when the spreadsheet or worksheet cannot be resolved, when the values payload is empty or not a 2D array of rows, or when the service lacks permission to edit the spreadsheet (including protected sheets).

tool_schemas.name: create_spreadsheet
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new spreadsheet with the provided title and returns its spreadsheet ID and basic metadata. Requests are refused when the title is missing/blank or fails validation for a spreadsheet name, or when the service is not allowed to create new spreadsheets under its configured Google account/drive.

tool_schemas.name: find_row
tool_schemas.description: Searches the worksheet for the first row where the cell under the named header column equals the provided value and returns the matched row (or an indication that no match was found). Requests are refused when the spreadsheet or worksheet cannot be resolved, when the specified header column does not exist (for example, missing or duplicate headers), or when the sheet content cannot be read due to insufficient permissions.

metadata.name: LedgerLeaf SheetOps Hub
metadata.description: Manages a curated set of operational tracking spreadsheets by creating them, looking them up by name, and reading, updating, appending, and finding rows for reporting workflows.
